remarks: This is the St Mary's condo you've been waiting for---bright, open and beautifully updated, offering high ceilings, exposed brick, and large south-facing windows AND eligible for a first-time homebuyer grant of up to $5000!  There is a large living room with a ceiling fan and newer carpeting (2025), a separate dining area and a galley-style kitchen with hardwood flooring. Appliances (electric stove, refrigerator, microwave and dishwasher) are included.  Adjacent to the living room is a step-up room with hardwood floors and an exposed brick wall. This room is suitable for an office, media room, or with a futon or sofa bed, it becomes a guest room. The bedroom has a ceiling fan, newer carpeting (2025) and a large walk-in closet with double-hung racks.  The updated bathroom has ceramic tile walls and floors, a large ceramic tile shower with a cast iron Kohler basin, and a modern Kohler vanity.  There is a double closet in the entry and a pantry closet in the kitchen for additional storage. There are five separate heating zones throughout and the owners have replaced the circuit breaker box in 2026.There is one assigned parking space in the secure, gated lot.  The complex offers a bright and clean laundry room and there is a dedicated 6' x 8' storage unit in the basement. The monthly association fee is $635 and includes common area maintenance, water, private trash removal, Spectrum cable with extended channel service and all exterior landscaping, plowing and maintenance. Located in the Allentown Preservation District, just steps from the Medical Campus, and close to downtown, the Elmwood Village and major highways.
